title: Range Shift Science Document Score (model-facing)
description: MODEL-FACING schema: only fields the LLM should generate. Pipeline-populated metadata (document_id, coder, codebook_version, coded_at) is merged in by the pipeline AFTER generation and is NOT in this schema. See schema_meta.json for the merged-record contract used in validation. One JSON object per document.

document_meta.description: Bibliographic fields the model READS OFF the document. Identity/coding metadata is NOT here — the pipeline owns that. Only `title` is required; other bibliographic fields are optional and the model may include additional ones (e.g. authors, publisher). This is descriptive metadata — kept permissive so a record's scored content isn't failed over a missing page count.

title.description: Document title as printed, or null if not determinable.

jurisdiction.description: e.g. state, agency, or 'federal'. null if unclear.

document_type.description: e.g. 'SWAP', 'climate adaptation plan'. null if unclear.

orientation.description: FIRST-EMITTED orientation pass. The model produces this BEFORE scoring any element, as its structured read of the document: a brief characterization plus an evidence index of candidate passages relevant to range-shift science, with locations. Scoring then draws on this index. This is the 'take notes first, then score against the notes' workflow folded into a single call. The evidence index is also an auditable artifact and feeds the downstream verbatim-quote check.

summary.description: 3-5 sentences: document genre/jurisdiction/year, overall posture toward climate change, posture toward range shifts specifically, and what analysis the document performs itself vs. references from elsewhere.

evidence_index.description: Candidate passages relevant to any codebook element, identified during orientation BEFORE scoring — the model's 'notes'. Permissive/high-recall: include anything potentially relevant; scoring applies the strict codebook thresholds and polysemy rules later. Empty array only if the document contains nothing relevant.

adaptive_capacity_components.description: Element 1.3. Multi-select checklist of adaptive capacity components referenced.

management_scale.description: Element 3.1. Multi-select checklist: which geopolitical/administrative/geographic scale(s) of management are discussed in range-shift contexts. Plus free-text named entities. (Retyped from scored 0-2 in codebook v0.4.)

named_entities.description: Free text: named entities (counties, watersheds, administrative flyways) discussed in range-shift contexts. Empty array if none.

biological_unit_components.description: Element 3.3. Which biological units are discussed in range-shift contexts.

named_entities.description: Free-text list of named entities (species, ecoregions, habitats) discussed in range-shift contexts. Empty array if none.

evidence_of_efficacy.description: Element 4.4. Scale 0-3 (enforced in validation). Whether evidence supporting action efficacy is presented, plus free-text project list.

adaptation_planning_frameworks.description: Element 4.5. Scale 0-2. Reference to climate adaptation planning processes/tools.

index_entry.description: One candidate passage from the orientation evidence index: a quote, where it is, and which codebook element(s) it may bear on. High-recall — inclusion here is NOT a score; scoring applies the codebook thresholds and polysemy rules later.

text.description: Verbatim candidate quote from the document, max 50 words / 500 chars.

location.description: Page number, section heading, or other locator. e.g. 'p. 142' or 'Ch. 4, sec. 4.2'.

relevant_elements.description: Codebook element IDs this passage may bear on (e.g. '1.4', '2.1', '4.2'). One passage may list several.

evidence_quote.description: A single supporting quote from the document.

text.description: Verbatim quote from the document, max 50 words / 500 chars (enforced in validation).

location.description: Page number, section heading, or other locator. e.g. 'p. 142' or 'Ch. 4, sec. 4.2'.

sub_component.description: For composite scores, which sub-component this quote supports (e.g. 'exposure', a component name), else null.

citations.description: Academic citations associated with this quote, verbatim, no normalization. Empty array if none.

scored_element.description: A standard scored element. 'evaluable' is the first-class unevaluable flag: when false, the element could not be assessed (unreadable section, missing pages) and 'score' should be ignored. This replaces the old nullable score. score=0 with evaluable=true means 'evaluated, topic absent' — a DIFFERENT state from evaluable=false.

evaluable.description: true = the element could be assessed (even if the conclusion is 0/absent). false = insufficient basis to evaluate at all.

score.description: Score per the codebook scale (range 0-3; used by 0-3 elements like 1.1). When evaluable=false, set score=0 and explain in absence_note.

evidence.description: Supporting quotes. 1-3 required if score > 0; empty array if score = 0 or not evaluable.

absence_note.description: Reasoning for close calls or for why the element was concluded absent/unevaluable. null if not applicable.

efficacy_element.description: Element 4.4 shape: a scored element (0-3) plus a free-text list of prior projects and the evidence they provide. 'evaluable' semantics identical to scored_element.

evaluable.description: true = the element could be assessed (even if the conclusion is 0/absent). false = insufficient basis to evaluate at all.

score.description: Score per the codebook scale for this element. Per-element range (0-3 / 0-2 / 0-1) enforced in validation. When evaluable=false, set score=0 and explain in absence_note.

evidence.description: Supporting quotes. 1-3 required if score > 0; empty array if score = 0 or not evaluable.

absence_note.description: Reasoning for close calls or for why the element was concluded absent/unevaluable. null if not applicable.

projects.description: Free text: prior projects that implemented an action, each with a 1-3 sentence summary of the evidence it provides for/against the action. Empty array if none.

component_flag.description: A boolean flag with required supporting evidence if true.

evidence.description: 1-3 supporting quotes required if present = true; empty array if false.

tool_element.description: A tools element: evaluable flag + score + named tools + evidence. score: 0 = not referenced; 1 = referenced generally; 2 = applied to the document's subject.

evaluable.description: true = assessable; false = insufficient basis to evaluate.

score.description: 0 = not referenced; 1 = referenced generally; 2 = applied to subject. Range 0-2 enforced in validation.

named_tools.description: Specific tools/models named (e.g. 'MaxEnt', 'CircuitScape'). Empty array if none.

climate_tool_element.description: Climate-models element. Same shape as tool_element plus time horizon and emission scenarios.

score.description: 0 = not referenced; 1 = referenced generally; 2 = applied to subject. Range 0-2 enforced in validation.

time_horizon_years.description: Projection endpoint years, e.g. [2050, 2100]. Empty array if none.
